On CNBC today they said: "At first, strong jobs was considered negative, and then maybe digesting it a bit, we saw that smaller wage increases is actually good news."

1710326392695435506.content: In an unusual alliance, Matt Gaetz is supporting Ro Khanna's proposal to ban members of Congress from trading stock, ban them from lobbying, and ban all lobbyist and PAC donations. Many members claim to support these reforms. But now it's time to back up rhetoric with action.
